units.source_text: 引自白居易《香炉峰下新卜山居草堂初成偶题东壁五首》第一首：

en.t: Quoted from the first of Bai Juyi's five poems titled On the East Wall When My Newly Chosen Mountain Cottage Below Incense Burner Peak Was Just Completed.

units.source_text: “五架三间新草堂，石阶桂柱竹编墙。

en.t: A new thatched cottage of five rafters and three bays, with stone steps, cassia pillars, and walls woven from bamboo.

units.source_text: 南檐纳日冬天暖，北户迎风夏月凉。”

en.t: The southern eaves take in the sun, making winter warm; the northern door welcomes the wind, making summer months cool.
